Note: After completing the main story, Chen will offer to organize your concert, but tells you that if there's anyone you haven't invited yet, to do so now. Players may infer from this that they should hold off on accepting this offer until they have achieved a Level 5 Bond with all rare customers, but this is not necessary; the player can redo the concert any time they like. A few things unlock after doing the concert for the first time, so it is recommended to do it as soon as it becomes available.
